reference_input_policy: Initial/replacement atlases generated from text informed by inspected references. Only attempted Air edit used attached image. No original Heroes pixels composited into effect PNGs.
fire:
Use-case: stylized-concept, production 2D magic VFX sprite atlas for Laema, a side-scrolling fantasy game. Generate ONE square 1024x1024 RGBA image with genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Strict invisible 4 columns by 4 rows uniform grid, each cell exactly 256x256, no drawn grid, no letters, no text, no numbers, no background or actors. All effects isolated inside their own cell, padded by at least 32px. Each cell has a fixed central pivot (128,128). Frame order left to right then top to bottom. Facing right.
FIRE palette: deep garnet and red-orange body, restrained pale apricot concentrated highlights, subtle umber shadow; no broad yellow/gold glow. Fine modeled shading reminiscent of original late-1990s Heroes III spell sprites: small tapering curled ribbons with dense colored core and tiny sharp highlights, carefully shaded volume, no enlarged blocky pixels, no bloom haze. This is ORIGINAL generated art, do not reproduce a Heroes spell symbol. No chalice/shield/icon.
ROW 1 (4 sequential frames): a small local CAST ACCENT one-shot, a curved licking flame ribbon forming at fixed center in frame1, curling in frame2, opening in frame3, reducing to two thin embers in frame4. Never a full body aura or ring.
ROW 2 (4 sequential cyclic frames): a compact rightward PROJECTILE, same size and center all four frames; dense oval flame nucleus pointing right, short turbulent ribbon tail to left. Head center remains (145,128), nucleus about50x38px; whole silhouette no more120x80px. Four close variations in flame contour, last flows back into first. No travel across the sheet.
ROWS 3 and 4 (8 sequential frames, left to right): a single small IMPACT one-shot from point (128,128), frame1 compact spark, frame2 small burst, frame3 maximum curl, frame4 break apart, frame5 thinning, frame6 two wisps, frame7 tiny ember, frame8 almost transparent. Maximum entire silhouette140x140px, centered; no explosion cloud or long rays.
Temporal continuity: consistent palette, changing shapes follow one coherent curl; no random new blobs, no duplicating independent explosions. Keep strong separation from neighboring cells and full transparency between. These are separate layers, never bake character, weapon, scenery, UI, floor, shadow or labels into pixels. The intended gameplay export is 50% atlas scale, small projectile core around25x19px beside a180px standing fighter. No ability/status/area symbols.
